about: Lists of joblist by need, made from the commons map of the commons research (komm1234/commons, /graph.json): one list per need, its organizations the commons a person can join, use or fund. scripts/curate-lists.js proposes them (a report, nothing written) from this file. kinds: the first rule whose words (or their plural) appear in what an entry is (its type before "with", "plus" or ";", or also its summary's first six words when the rule says so) gives its kind; what follows "not" never counts; none: left unknown (wrong is worse than unknown). networks: an entry whose type starts with one of these words is a network of many organizations, shown as one entry point (its umbrella's website) and tagged so. write: what scripts/curate-lists.js --write writes (from an account in config.bots, so each record shows as not checked by a person yet): at most companiesPerRun new organizations a run, in batches with pauses; each description ends with the credit.

lists.name: Housing commons
lists.description: Homes kept out of the market: housing co-ops, community land trusts, tenants' movements. Join, live in, fund or work with them.

lists.name: Food commons
lists.description: Food grown, shared and sold together: farmers' and consumers' co-ops, community-supported agriculture, peasant movements.

lists.name: Energy commons
lists.description: Energy owned by the people who use it: community energy co-ops, citizen power plants, their federations.

lists.name: Care commons
lists.description: Health and care run by the people who give and receive it: care co-ops, community clinics, mutual aid.

lists.name: Digital commons
lists.description: Software, networks and services owned by their communities: free software, community networks, co-op hosting, open protocols.

lists.name: Land and nature commons
lists.description: Land and nature cared for by the people who live with them: community forests, land trusts, indigenous territories.

lists.name: Money commons
lists.description: Money that serves its members: credit unions, co-op banks, ethical lenders, mutual funds.

lists.name: Knowledge commons
lists.description: Knowledge free for all: open encyclopedias, maps, libraries and archives, and the people who make them.

lists.name: Peace commons
lists.description: Peace made by communities: peacebuilding, mediation and nonviolence networks.
